items.title: Ray Shiner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 1998
items.q: Lester Young was still functioning and so was Billie Holiday, so was Benny Carter, you know a lot of great, famous musicians

ctx.x: Was there a place that you musicians hung out in New York waiting for calls and so forth?

Yeah. Well there were several places. We hung out at Joe Harbor’s Spotlight Cafe, or Juniors, or the Confucius Chinese Restaurant. Of course the Band Box was there at that time and Basin Street was there, and Lester Young was still functioning and so was Billie Holiday, so was Benny Carter, you know a lot of great, famous musicians, Jack Teagarden. This is going back quite a few years.
What’s this place Jim & Andy’s bar?
